cards.text: Jesus has died on the cross (Matthew 27:50). Now it's evening, and a rich man from Arimathea named Joseph comes, and he himself was a disciple of Jesus. He goes to Pilate, the governor who handed Jesus over to be crucified (Matthew 27:26), with a request.

cards.question: Joseph from Arimathea goes to Pilate the governor and asks for the ___ of Jesus.

cards.text: Pilate orders that the body be given to him. So Joseph takes the body of Jesus and gets it ready for burial.

cards.question: Joseph from Arimathea wraps the body of Jesus in a clean linen cloth.

cards.text: Then Joseph places the body in a tomb cut into the rock. Remember, friend, this man is rich, and he's a disciple of Jesus.

cards.question: Joseph from Arimathea places the body of Jesus in a tomb cut into the rock. Whose tomb is it?
Joseph closes up the tomb cut into the rock. He rolls a great ___ across the entrance and goes away.
Joseph is gone, but two women are sitting opposite the tomb where Jesus was laid. Who are they?

answers.text: Mary Magdalene and the other Mary

cards.text: The next day, the one after Preparation Day, the chief priests and Pharisees gather in front of Pilate, and that man cannot catch a BREAK. They've come about Jesus' tomb and about something He said while He was alive.

cards.question: The chief priests and Pharisees tell Pilate they remember something Jesus said while He was alive. What was it?

answers.text: After three days I will rise again
I will come down from the cross
Elijah will come to save Me

cards.text: They call Jesus a deceiver, but look at that, friend: they remembered what He said. So they ask Pilate to give the order that the tomb be secured until the third day.

cards.question: The chief priests and Pharisees want Jesus' tomb secured until the third day. What do they say could happen otherwise?

answers.text: The crowds riot at the tomb

cards.text: They say that if the disciples then tell the people He has risen from the dead, "…this last deception would be worse than the first." "You have a guard," Pilate says.

cards.question: Pilate tells the chief priests and Pharisees to make the tomb as secure as they know how.

cards.text: Pilate is every boss who ever said, "Handle it however you want." So off they go to the tomb.

cards.question: At Jesus' tomb, the chief priests and Pharisees decide not to post a guard.

cards.text: So they seal the stone and post the guard, and friend, I've sealed a LOT of cookie boxes without ever needing a guard on one. Trust me, this story is NOT over.
